NQR8 Division 3 Champion(s) ([[Bad Luck Troopers]])

Arranging [http://www.qhlan.org/ QHLAN #10] 4-7 January 2007 in Märsta (responsible for the QHLAN servers that were run with the BLT POWAH KTX server pack)

Arranging [http://www.qhlan.org/ QHLAN 2017] (responsible for the Tastyspleen.tv Twitch broadcast audio and producing the QHLAN 2017 Original Soundtrack "Dark Zones & Bad Places")

Lots of IRL success since 2005 ;-) ([http://www.sae.edu/ SAE Institute, School of Audio Engineering]) (stop idling!)

Audio Engineer, Music Producer, DJ & Linux Cybersecurity Engineer. 

Still playing QW sometimes for fun with the BLT-gang and QHLAN/Tältlan Crew.
